content.text:
Apple Cuts iPhone 18 Pro Orders 15-20% as Memory Costs Bite: Reports that Apple asked some suppliers to reduce October iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max component orders by at least 15% versus initial requests, attributing softer demand to memory-cost-driven price increases. It also relays a possible launch-schedule explanation for weaker device demand; it does not independently verify the underlying supplier account. (time=2026-10-09T08:07:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
OpenAI annualized revenue $20 billion less than previously reported: Reports an approximately $50 billion September annualized-revenue figure versus approximately $70 billion widely reported in September. Axios says the higher comparison reflected attempts to gross up partner sales to align OpenAI's metric with Anthropic's; the article cautions that annualized revenue is not the same as publicly reported actual-period revenue. (time=2026-10-08T19:50:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Scoop: OpenAI's annual recurring revenue nears $70B: Reports that OpenAI's annualized revenue run rate was nearing $70 billion, with enterprise sales more than doubling since July, citing people familiar with the financials. This documents the earlier publicly reported figure, not an audited or official revenue statement. (time=2026-09-29T14:15:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
